answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36593 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I am a female, 26 years now. Since that Kosovo/Chechnya war took place, I get many dreams till today Question: I am a female, 26 years now. Since that Kosovo/Chechnya war took place, I get many dreams till today that I am fighting with kafir soldiers, I dream I am a Palestinian trying to compromise with them not to kill my Muslims, or I get dreams that I am a very pious man and they are after me with guns. Please interpret this for me. Answer ID: 36593 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 270/153/H=1433) The dream indicates that you lag far behind in simplicity and hospitality. And in another way the dream is very nice that it warns that you are in dire need to reform yourself ignoring the glittering of the world. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
